# Santa Barbara Marketing Co (full)
> Marketing agency based in Santa Barbara, CA, serving all of Santa Barbara County.
> Websites live in 30 days, local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google and Meta ads,
> and a full CRM with follow-up. English and Spanish. Founded 2026 by Ruben Ruiz,
> who has marketed local businesses since 2007. Formerly Ranking SB.

## Identity
- Legal / brand name: Santa Barbara Marketing Co
- Short name: SBMC

- URL: https://www.sbmc.io

## Offer
- Product: The Local Lead Plan
- Monthly: $297/mo
- Yearly: $2,970/yr (2 months free)
- Includes: marketing website, lead follow-up, missed-call text back, review requests, local SEO, on-site SEO
- Typical website launch: about 30 days after logins, photos, and content are provided
- Cancel anytime with 30-day written notice
- Add-ons: Voice AI $99/mo, Chat AI $29/mo (optional; not included in the plan)

## Service area
Santa Barbara County, CA, including Santa Barbara, Goleta, Montecito, Carpinteria, Summerland, Isla Vista, Hope Ranch, Santa Maria, Lompoc, Orcutt, Guadalupe, Buellton, Solvang, Santa Ynez, Los Olivos, Ballard, Los Alamos, New Cuyama.
